stemMarkdown: A shop offers two successive discounts of 12% and 22% on an item. What single discount percentage is equivalent to these two? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Take MP $= 100$. After 12%: $88$. After a further 22%: $68.64$. The total discount is $100 - 68.64 = 31.36\%$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Equivalent discount $= d_1 + d_2 - \dfrac{d_1 d_2}{100} = 12 + 22 - \dfrac{264}{100} = 31.36\%$. Note it is **not** $34\%$.
